title: ASTC RGB versus CPU BT.709 4:2:0 input proxy
status: CPU proxy inputs prepared for the bounded ASTC colour-input comparison

fixtures.model: sRGB decode/encode roundtrip; production foveation full-range BT.709 matrix; per-pixel R8 luma; 2x2 arithmetic-mean R8G8 chroma; ASTC pixel() nearest p/2 chroma fetch and inverse matrix; clamp and round reconstructed CPU reference to RGBA8
fixtures.rounding: NumPy rint (nearest, ties-to-even); actual GPU imageStore R8 quantization may differ at exact ties
fixtures.not_claimed: not output from the production GPU foveation pass; does not model foveation geometry, resampling, or implementation-specific UNORM conversion
